description: Cline 3.0 sessions.db sanitized row set (cline/cline@main 2026-10-07 source summary: sessions table with session_id and metadata_json carrying usage/aggregateUsage aggregates). Same column shapes, rewritten ids/titles/counts; no real keys or hosts. Tests synthesize the SQLite index deterministically from these rows (mimo/zcode in-test pattern). Per-message metrics semantics: inputTokens excludes cache read/write; both cache directions are explicit. The stale row proves an index entry without an on-disk session directory surfaces as a failed source instead of silently disappearing.
